protocol: Selected USAF altitude chamber operations staff. All had more than 50 previous occupational exposures above 25,000 ft lasting 30–60 minutes.
outcome_window: Retrospective occupational history at MRI recruitment. Dates, episode counts and a common clinical observation period are unavailable.
locator: Subjects, recruitment and self-reported mission-related neurological DCS
note: Two of 83 selected altitude chamber operations staff reported a history of mission-related neurological DCS symptoms. None of the study subjects reported NDCS from periodic qualification chamber training. The paper supplies no count of qualification exposures and no common clinical surveillance window.

protocol: Voluntary active-duty U-2 pilots with recurrent occupational flight cabin altitude 28,000–30,000 ft for up to nine hours.
outcome_window: Retrospective occupational history at MRI recruitment. Dates, episode counts and a common clinical observation period are unavailable.
locator: Subjects, recruitment and self-reported mission-related neurological DCS
note: Sixteen of 105 selected U-2 pilots reported mission-related neurological DCS symptoms in Methods. Table 2 separately excludes 22 pilots by subtraction for its MRI analysis without clinical NDCS. The publication gives no participant crosswalk explaining the difference.
